metadata.title: Ferrari vs. Tesla: Can the Luce Outsell the Roadster?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Ferrari vs. Tesla: Can the Luce Outsell the Roadster?
Ferrari on Wednesday reported as-expected third-quarter results. Sales of $2.1 billion matched Wall Street projections. Shares rose 4.3% on Wednesday.
